notes: Update checks now defeat GitHub's cache lag and repeat every 5 minutes
patch_notes: The update check itself is fixed: GitHub's raw file cache can lag minutes behind a publish (each region on its own clock), and the app used to check only once at startup — a stale read meant no banner until a lucky restart. Checks now bypass the cache and repeat every 5 minutes while the app runs, so an update lands in the tray notification on its own, no restart needed.
